name: controlled-held-out-evaluation-v2
description: Frozen Tangle SetMembership and Banyan CheckDepth vulnerable/fixed pairs selected before backend execution. Subtract and Reclaim causes are excluded.

targets.label: Tangle SetMembership vulnerable
targets.input_assumptions: element and set[0..2] are canonical BN128 field elements. Membership is equality in the field; no narrower integer range or caller-only precondition is imposed.

known_defects.location: circuits/set/membership.circom:17-26; product[0] is initialized to element instead of 1
known_defects.local_reproduction: Exact source revision and SetMembership(3) direct wrapper compile in the frozen comparison environment; no v2 backend result is assigned before execution.
known_defects.reachability: Direct original component only; whole-project caller reachability is reported separately.

targets.label: Tangle SetMembership fixed comparator
targets.input_assumptions: element and set[0..2] are canonical BN128 field elements. Membership is equality in the field; no narrower integer range or caller-only precondition is imposed.

targets.label: Banyan Blake3 CheckDepth vulnerable
targets.input_assumptions: depth and leaf_depth are canonical BN128 field elements. The component itself is required to reject values outside unsigned 8-bit range before applying 8-bit comparators; no caller-only range assumption is added.

known_defects.location: circuits/blake3_nova.circom:13-39; depth and leaf_depth reach 8-bit comparators without range constraints
known_defects.local_reproduction: Exact source revision and direct wrapper compile in the frozen comparison environment; no v2 backend result is assigned before execution.
known_defects.reachability: Direct original component only; whole-project caller reachability and impact are reported separately.

targets.label: Banyan Blake3 CheckDepth fixed comparator
targets.input_assumptions: depth and leaf_depth are canonical BN128 field elements. This fixed comparator is expected to enforce unsigned 8-bit range internally before applying the comparators.

exclusions.label: Subtract vulnerable/fixed pair
exclusions.reason: controlled-v1.1 outcomes were already observed, so Subtract is a development positive control and is excluded from the held-out metric.

exclusions.label: Reclaim Add32Bits, XorWords, RotateLeft32Bits and variants
exclusions.reason: Their causes and candidates were used in dev3 development and validation work.

exclusions.label: SIV ExtractStringFromPoint
exclusions.reason: The pinned fix source uses RShift1(5), while the zkbugs narrative says RShift1(8) and the project encoder permits first-byte values through 60; the fixed comparator contract is therefore ambiguous over the documented caller domain.

exclusions.label: Aptos Base64DecodedLength
exclusions.reason: Pre-execution preparation rejected the vulnerable source syntax as incomplete in the frozen zkfDO parser, and the fixed source pragma 2.2.2 is rejected by the frozen zkFuzz frontend using Circom 2.2.1.

exclusions.label: Telepathy ArrayXOR
exclusions.reason: Pre-execution preparation rejected component arrays in the fixed ByteArrayXOR source as unsupported by the frozen zkfDO parser.

exclusions.label: zk-email FpMul and other local Circom records
exclusions.reason: Not selected after two independent causes met the minimum. No validity or safety judgment is made about unselected records.
